_doc: Orders for Tripo's API (tools/models/tripo.py, run by .github/workflows/models.yml when this file changes on main; needs the secret TRIPO_API_KEY). Key — the model's name (content/art/models/<name>.glb); a model already there is not ordered again unless "redo": true. image — the picture to make it from; faces — the generator's face limit; for — what it replaces on the map (see models.json); front — degrees that turn its front to the street; rig — skeleton type (biped, quadruped, hexapod, octopod, avian, serpentine, aquatic); animations — the API's preset names (for all rig types: preset:idle, walk, run, jump, slash, shoot, hurt, fall, turn, climb, dive; for animals preset:quadruped:walk, preset:octopod:walk, preset:hexapod:walk, preset:serpentine:march, preset:aquatic:march). Prices (12.10.2026): model with HD texture ~40 credits, rig 25, an animation 10; 100 credits = $1.
